name: Configuration and semantic qualification
intervention: Map author configuration names to real frozen entry points; audit clocks, metrics and writes
baseline_controls: Same source content, durability, budgets and realized object layout
primary_metrics: mount identity; lower type; runtime path; actual g/B/q; readback
implementation_gate: Real commands and source/config/image manifest; fork/read-only/migration capability readback
weakening_outcome: Unsupported path or unmatched semantics excludes the corresponding causal contrast

name: Overlay overhead and edited-parent fork
intervention: Add overlay without Packed; compare common operations then equivalent child creation
baseline_controls: native versus native-overlay; metadata materialization adapter with shared payload; JuiceFS clone
primary_metrics: ready/first correct operation; durable edit/save; database records; bytes; isolation
implementation_gate: Edited parent changes inherited by children; isolated writes; remote confirmation
weakening_outcome: No creation savings or higher everyday overhead; advantage vanishes with fair clone

name: Retained state and reclamation
intervention: Increase recoverable state count and delete half
baseline_controls: Same byte changes, retained version lifetime and payload sharing
primary_metrics: correctly retained/reopened states; metadata/object byte-time; cleanup lag
implementation_gate: Recoverable state inventory and reference-safe reclamation
weakening_outcome: Admission failures; source rows retained; cleanup cannot keep up

name: Packed access and metadata-service interference
intervention: Switch fixed lower representation; separately query and run mutable probes
baseline_controls: Identical frozen content and payload locations, same upper/cache/layout; cold/index-warm/metadata-warm
primary_metrics: lower/upper/control DB requests; DB CPU/memory/bytes; probe deadlines/p95; object traffic; client CPU
implementation_gate: Matched fixed-version paths and per-service instrumentation; no automatic source deletion
weakening_outcome: Warm native or low locality wins; central relief offset by cold object fetches or probe regressions

name: First fork and version reuse economics
intervention: Time from writable source to first useful child and repeated version reuse
baseline_controls: Native seal/binding versus capture/pack/upload/validate/publish; prepublished reuse separately
primary_metrics: first-child and batch elapsed; construction CPU/requests/bytes; DB/object byte-time; per-metric cost difference
implementation_gate: Consistent source capture; exact source retention; no presumed incremental packer
weakening_outcome: No break-even in measured range, frequent rebuilds, low reuse, or unresolved retained source footprint

name: Client object size and backend layout
intervention: Vary g at fixed backend; then B/q on fixed objects/request streams; then fetching policy
baseline_controls: Same data, code rate, cache/prefetch/coalescing and actual effective geometry
primary_metrics: object count; HTTP/device bytes; checksum/encoding CPU; durable write; repair traffic; tool time
implementation_gate: Admitted persisted layouts and instrumented bytes; extensions separately identified
weakening_outcome: Same effective layout; whole-object verification erases savings; write/repair cost exceeds read savings

name: Partial workspace migration
intervention: Move selected workspaces at tool boundaries
baseline_controls: Native/packed separately; no-move paired run; JuiceFS reopen original directory
implementation_gate: Verified writer handoff and state identity; targets ready; measured node placement
weakening_outcome: Fast reopen shifts cost to earlier packing; cold target stalls; neighbor interference

name: Failure and stale-writer validation
baseline_controls: Same committed-state and stale-writer contract, external termination separately labeled
primary_metrics: confirmed-state correctness; stale writes; lost/repeated work; recovery outcome
implementation_gate: Independent reader checks content; actually attempt stale writes
weakening_outcome: Acknowledged data lost; stale writer succeeds; unsupported takeover

name: Fixed work replay
intervention: Run identical 56 assignments at different concurrency
baseline_controls: Same 7 archives and ordered callback replay; BrewFS versus JuiceFS; qualified internal contrasts separately
primary_metrics: correct completion curve; makespan if all succeed; per-case latency; resources/cost
implementation_gate: Single-case final-tree validation; coordinator and common deadline; replay CPU monitored
weakening_outcome: No useful completion gain; parser bottleneck; failed assigned work

name: Fixed backend with growing client load
intervention: Increase workers and proportional assigned work
baseline_controls: Same per-worker CPU/memory/cache and fixed storage budget
primary_metrics: correct tasks/s; per-case slowdown; metadata/object pressure; assigned failures
implementation_gate: Actual node placement and 7-case frozen schedule; no inference of fixed-work speedup
weakening_outcome: Metadata or storage saturates; memory growth; low completion rate

name: Real session fork and continuation
intervention: Fork four child sessions or migrate one after third complete tool result
baseline_controls: Paired no-fork/no-move with same initial task, model and total budget
primary_metrics: session lineage; first subsequent tool result; grade; model cost; repeated tools
implementation_gate: Real session API and final grading, not synthetic state-file copy
weakening_outcome: File replay passes but session cannot continue; budget inflation; no task-level benefit
